correctness.rationale: Starting from A=u phi and B=v psi with phi(u)=psi(v)=0, images of nonzero AB and BA force commuting iff both vanish (including shared-image case). For a commuting family U=sum im A lies in every kernel; X_U is complete and maximal, and its sum-of-images/meet-of-kernels both equal U, proving unique classification. Count by projective pairs (image line in U, functional in U^perp), use q-subspace Möbius (-1)^d q^(d(d-1)/2) to enforce exact image span in each ordered k-tuple, and signed Stirling inversion to get every clique coefficient. A fixed line/kernel count gives degree. In n=3 flags L⊂H are incidence-graph edges, giving line-graph diameter 3; n>=4 find w in ker A∩ker B and eta killing im A,im B,w to give common commuting neighbor; n=2 components are lines. Independent structural checks match. No finite enumeration extrapolation.
